episode_title: 377. How to Get More Clients: The Sales Process I Use When I Need $CHMONEY

real_qa.q: What is the core difference between visibility activities and actual sales activities when generating clients?
real_qa.r: Visibility and sales activities are not the same thing. Content has a role and supports your sales process, but visibility is not the entire sales process. Many people jump the gun by starting with content when they really need to start with sales or the entire pipeline.
real_qa.requete: visibility versus sales activities lead generation

real_qa.q: How should service providers calculate the exact number of client conversations needed to reach revenue goals?
real_qa.r: Start by turning vague goals into concrete numbers: if you need $3,000 and are selling a $1,000 offer, you need exactly three sales. Work backwards to determine how many people you need to talk to based on your conversion rate. For example, if your conversion rate is 90% on sales calls, you need roughly four sales calls to convert three clients.
real_qa.requete: calculate sales calls needed revenue target conversion rate

real_qa.q: Should entrepreneurs focus on creating new content before reaching out to existing warm leads in their pipeline?
real_qa.r: No. Before creating content, focus on who is already in your world—past clients, people who said 'not right now', warm leads you are nurturing, referrals, and people who have engaged with you. These existing relationships should be your first priority before generating new leads from strangers. Many successful offers have been launched to warm audiences without creating new content.
real_qa.requete: warm leads versus new content strategy launch

real_qa.q: What baseline conversion rate should service providers expect when prospecting potential clients?
real_qa.r: A good baseline is to convert at 20% of your conversations into sales. This means one out of every five conversations should turn into a client. However, your actual conversion rate will vary depending on the sales method—for instance, 90% conversion on sales calls versus lower rates with DM-based sales.

real_qa.q: How does lead generation differ from cold pitching when building a sustainable client pipeline?
real_qa.r: Lead generation is about intentionally finding people who fit your buyer profile and building genuine relationships with them, not immediately pitching. It is a balancing act where you get to know someone, assess if they have the problem you solve, and determine if they might invest in themselves. This approach treats people as human beings and future potential clients, not just numbers to hit your launch goals.
real_qa.requete: lead generation versus cold pitching relationship building

real_quote: Visibility and sales activities are not the same thing. Content has a role, but visibility supports your sales process. It's not the entire sales process.
